classifiedFinding.title: setDispatcherHook lacks input validation (no zero check, no contract-existence probe, no interface conformance check); EOA or wrong-interface address causes all interactions to revert

classification.assetImpact: Owner misconfiguration freezes the pool for stake/unstake/claim until owner re-sets the hook. Users forced through emergencyWithdraw forfeit rewards. No external-attacker path.
attackPath: 1. Owner scripts a deployment with a bad dispatcher hook address (typo, wrong network, unrelated contract, or EOA).
2. Next stake / unstake / claim reverts at dispatcherHook.pull() inside _syncBudget (or at dispatcherHook.mintDebt() inside _recomputeSchedule).
3. Users wait for owner correction or take emergencyWithdraw.
classification.assumptions: Owner installs a non-zero, non-interface-conformant address.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. Input-validation gap with loud failure mode (every interaction reverts). Combined with C-01 widens the freeze window when hook rotation is fumbled. Recommendation: validate contract-existence and probe a low-level mintDebt() staticcall before persisting, or perform a probing _syncBudget inside the setter.
